string.text: Players will be able to deploy 1x field cannon for every 6x artillery units that you have in your party, up to a maximum of 6x cannons. Artillery units include Engineers, Gunners, Bomardiers, Artillery Officers, Humbaracı, etc. During the formation phase, players can position their artillery units where they wish (default formation is 1/Infantry). Once you like your position, press K to deploy the cannons. They will spawn directly in front of your artillery units. Note that you can still move the formation and the cannons until you begin the battle. As soon as you start the battle, your artillery units will start using the cannons automatically.
